svg.title: Bigtable row key and column families
svg.desc: The mock member_context_table has a row key of member ID, a hash sign, and event date, plus one column family per source: call_summary and member_details. Two rows for member MBR-000123 sit next to each other, so a prefix scan on MBR-000123# returns both. A row for a different member, MBR-000456, is skipped.
svg.text: Member ID first spreads writes; date second keeps a member's rows together, in order.
A new source is a new column family, with no schema change.
